# Kubernetes permissions

OpenConsole talks to each cluster with the identity you give it under **Admin → Clusters**, normally the ServiceAccount of `deploy/rbac.yaml`. That ClusterRole is the ceiling: a user can never do more in a cluster than it allows, whatever their OpenConsole roles grant. Remove a rule if you will never grant the matching permission. For a console that can only look, apply `deploy/rbac-readonly.yaml` instead (same object names, so applying one replaces the other).

## Full (`deploy/rbac.yaml`)

| API group | Resources | Verbs | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| core | `namespaces`, `pods`, `services`, `configmaps`, `events` | `get`, `list`, `watch` | Reads for every Dashboard tab + events for the Live Events panel. |
| core | `secrets` | `get`, `list`, `update` | Secrets tab: get / list for secrets:list / get / reveal, update for secrets:edit (YAML editor). No watch: secrets are read on demand, never cached. Drop `update` if you won't grant secrets:edit, or the whole rule if you won't grant any secrets permission. |
| core | `pods/log` | `get` | Pod logs (pods:logs). |
| core | `pods/exec` | `create` | Pod shell (pods:exec). |
| core | `pods`, `services`, `configmaps` | `update` | YAML apply ({resource}:edit) on core resources. |
| apps | `deployments`, `daemonsets`, `statefulsets` | `get`, `list`, `watch`, `update` | Deployments, DaemonSets and StatefulSets tabs; update for YAML apply. |
| apps | `replicasets` | `get`, `list` | Deployment revisions in the detail view (read only, no rollback). |
| metrics.k8s.io | `pods`, `nodes` | `get`, `list` | Pod CPU / memory (metrics-server), sampled every 30 s; node usage for Overview and Nodes. |
| core | `nodes` | `get`, `list`, `watch` | Admin → Overview (node strip) and Nodes. watch keeps nodes in the informer cache; without it OpenConsole lists them on each request. |
| core | `services/proxy` (only `monitoring-kube-prometheus-prometheus:9090`) | `get` | **Not granted** (commented out in the file). Optional: Prometheus "in the cluster (API server proxy)" mode (Admin → Clusters → Prometheus). Off by default: services/proxy lets the token send GET requests to the Service, so name only your Prometheus Service. |
| apps | `deployments` | `patch` | Deployment restart (deployments:restart) patches the pod template. |
| apps | `deployments/scale`, `statefulsets/scale` | `get`, `update` | Scale (deployments:scale, statefulsets:scale). |
| autoscaling | `horizontalpodautoscalers` | `get`, `list`, `watch`, `update` | HPA tab (autoscaling/v2); update for YAML apply (hpas:edit). |
| networking.k8s.io | `ingresses` | `get`, `list`, `watch`, `update` | Ingresses tab; update for YAML apply (ingresses:edit). |
| batch | `cronjobs`, `jobs` | `get`, `list`, `watch`, `update` | CronJobs and Jobs tabs; update for YAML apply (cronjobs:edit, jobs:edit). |

## Read only (`deploy/rbac-readonly.yaml`)

| API group | Resources | Verbs | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| core | `namespaces`, `pods`, `services`, `configmaps`, `events` | `get`, `list`, `watch` | Reads for every Dashboard tab + events for the Live Events panel. |
| core | `pods/log` | `get` | Pod / deployment / job logs. Logs can contain sensitive data too — drop this rule if read-only should mean "no logs" as well. |
| core | `secrets` | `get`, `list` | **Not granted** (commented out in the file). Secrets: deliberately omitted. Note that `get` on secrets lets the ServiceAccount read values, so enabling it is not "metadata only" at the Kubernetes level — OpenConsole's secrets:reveal permission is then the only thing keeping values hidden from users. |
| apps | `deployments`, `daemonsets`, `statefulsets` | `get`, `list`, `watch` | Deployments, DaemonSets and StatefulSets tabs. |
| apps | `replicasets` | `get`, `list` | Deployment revisions in the detail view (read only, no rollback). |
| metrics.k8s.io | `pods`, `nodes` | `get`, `list` | Pod CPU / memory (metrics-server), sampled every 30 s; node usage for Overview and Nodes. |
| core | `nodes` | `get`, `list`, `watch` | Admin → Overview (node strip) and Nodes. watch keeps nodes in the informer cache; without it OpenConsole lists them on each request. |
| core | `services/proxy` (only `monitoring-kube-prometheus-prometheus:9090`) | `get` | **Not granted** (commented out in the file). Optional: Prometheus "in the cluster (API server proxy)" mode (Admin → Clusters → Prometheus). Off by default: services/proxy lets the token send GET requests to the Service, so name only your Prometheus Service. |
| autoscaling | `horizontalpodautoscalers` | `get`, `list`, `watch` | HPA tab (autoscaling/v2). |
| networking.k8s.io | `ingresses` | `get`, `list`, `watch` | Ingresses tab. |
| batch | `cronjobs`, `jobs` | `get`, `list`, `watch` | CronJobs and Jobs tabs. |
